# FAQ-001 Engineering FAQ #1
Revision: Rev A

Q: What torque should be used on the main ram bolt for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02)?
A: The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 1330 N·m. Background: This torque value is set to maintain clamping preload on the ram assembly without overstressing the bolt or mating threads. Rationale: Using the specified torque ensures the ram remains secure under operational loads and minimizes fretting and relative movement at the joint. Example procedure: clean threads, apply manufacturer‑approved lubricant to the bolt shank and threads as specified in EQ-P1-L3-HP02 maintenance references, and use a calibrated torque wrench to apply 1330 N·m. Records to keep: torque application log entry showing equipment id EQ-P1-L3-HP02, bolt identifier, technician name, tool calibration id, and confirmation that 1330 N·m was achieved. See ECN-2026-034 for the associated design change rationale and SB-1017 for special bolting precautions.

Q: What is the lubrication interval for the main roll bearing on Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01)?
A: The main roll bearing lubrication interval for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 120 hours. Background: Regular lubrication maintains film strength in the bearing contact and removes heat and contaminants. Rationale: The 120 hours service interval balances lubricant life, bearing temperature rise, and production duty for the bearing application specified in EQ-P1-L1-RR01. Example application: top up or renew grease type approved for the bearing following locked‑out mill conditions; perform visual checks at lubricant points between scheduled lubrication events. Records to keep: lubrication log for EQ-P1-L1-RR01 listing date/time, operating hours counter reading at service (if available), lubricant batch/lot id, amount or cartridge id used, technician initials, and any anomalies observed. See SOP-P2-L2-04 for procedural steps and ECN-2026-034 for any post‑modification lubrication notes.

Q: What is the system pressure limit for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01)?
A: The system pressure limit for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 330 bar. Background: The pressure limit reflects component rating for the hydraulic circuit and the safety margin required by the press design. Rationale: Operating at or below 330 bar ensures seals, hoses, valves, and actuators remain within their rated capabilities and reduces risk of catastrophic failure. Example operational control: verify pressure gauge readings and relief valve settings against the 330 bar limit before press operation; do not permit operations that cause excursions above 330 bar. Records to keep: pressure verification record for EQ-P3-L1-HP01 capturing gauge calibration reference, pre‑operation pressure check, relief valve set confirmation, operator name, and any corrective actions taken if readings approach the 330 bar limit. Reference ECN-2026-034 for design acceptance and SB-1017 for any special hydraulic system instructions.

Q: What torque should be used on the mandrel clamp bolts for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03)?
A: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 620 N·m. Background: Correct clamp bolt torque secures the mandrel to resist torsional and radial loads during ring forming. Rationale: Specifying 620 N·m provides sufficient clamp force to prevent slippage while avoiding overstress of the clamp hardware or mandrel assembly. Example procedure: degrease mating surfaces, finger‑start bolts, torque in a star or sequence recommended for the clamp geometry, and use a calibrated torque wrench to reach 620 N·m. Records to keep: clamping torque record for EQ-P2-L2-RR03 including bolt identifiers, torque tool calibration id, operator, and confirmation that 620 N·m was achieved. See SOP-P2-L2-04 for clamp sequencing and ECN-2026-034 for any design notes affecting clamp torque.

Q: What is the maximum allowable ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03)?
A: The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 1525 mm. Background: The outer diameter limit is driven by roll contact geometry, mandrel capacity, and guarding envelope for EQ-P2-L2-RR03. Rationale: Adhering to the 1525 mm limit prevents interference with roll frames, maintains safe clearances for guards, and ensures accurate rolling profiles. Example planning: for parts approaching the 1525 mm limit, confirm tooling setup, verify guard positions, and coordinate handling fixtures rated for that diameter. Records to keep: part setup record listing final ring outer diameter measurement, tooling identifiers, operator name, and any deviations or concessions approved per ECN-2026-034. See SB-1017 for special handling notes and SOP-P2-L2-04 for setup and measurement procedures.

- SB-1017
- SOP-P2-L2-04
